title: A Johnny Bravo Christmas
overview: On Christmas Eve Johnny realizes he forgot to mail his and Momma's wish lists to Santa. In order to ensure that he gets all the "free stuff" he has been looking forward to Johnny decides to head to the North pole himself and has the holiday adventure of a life time and learns the true meaning of Christmas
